name: Iowa
standard: WCAG 2.0 A and AA (Section 508 governs where federal funding requires it)

laws.summary: Rules used to enforce and waive state IT operational standards.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

applies_to: State agencies listed in Iowa Code § 8A.201(5), boards and commissions, and contractors who build or maintain state websites.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Meet WCAG 2.0 A/AA for new web content; earlier content is grandfathered
Post accessibility notices per the Website Policy Notices Standard
Standard reviewed at least every two years
mobile: not addressed — the standard covers websites only.
procurement: State website RFPs must reference the standard, and awarded contracts must include a written acknowledgment that the product will comply.
enforcement: Enforced under Iowa Admin. Code 11-25.9; waiver requests go in writing to the State CIO or DAS Director.
notes: Both official pages opened show WCAG 2.0 (2012). A search snippet claimed a WCAG 2.1 version and cited a 2017 PDF; neither was verified. The Website Policy Notices Standard was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
